theme.affects: Page, text, links, surfaces and native controls; auto follows device colours

accent.affects: Primary buttons and native checkbox, radio, range, progress and meter accents; links retain their readable theme colour

shape.affects: Buttons, text controls, cards, menus, disclosures, fieldsets, dialogs, popovers, tables, images, videos and code

fill.affects: Button gradients and optional glass sheen

density.affects: Surface padding, control padding, table cells and layout spacing

depth.affects: Buttons, cards, fieldsets, disclosures, dialogs, popovers, menus and desktop panels; control inset shadows use data-controls

motion.affects: Button transitions and press movement; reduced-motion preference wins

border.affects: Styled control and surface borders, table rules and menu panel separators; invalid and forced-colour boundaries win

contrast.affects: Readable text and boundary colours; optional glass becomes opaque; device high-contrast preference wins

tone.affects: Neutral, cool or warm page and surface backgrounds

controls.affects: Text input, select and textarea fill and inset shadow

table.affects: Table stripes and grid lines; grid thickness follows data-border

size.scope: Inherited; affects controls and menu actions
size.affects: Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, .button links and menu actions; native touch target minimums remain

ratio.affects: Image and video aspect ratio; auto retains natural proportions

fit.scope: Inherited; affects constrained images and videos
fit.affects: Image and video content within constrained dimensions

gap.affects: Spacing in .grid, .row and .stack; combines with density

material.scope: Inherited material scope; optional glass stylesheet
material.affects: Surface material; glass requires the optional glass stylesheet; solid stops inherited glass
